command:
for i in $$(seq 60); do
  aws --endpoint-url http://seaweedfs:8333 s3 mb s3://neon 2>/dev/null ||
    aws --endpoint-url http://seaweedfs:8333 s3 ls s3://neon >/dev/null && exit 0
  sleep 2
done
exit 1

entrypoint:
set -eu
umask 077
pw=""
IFS= read -r pw <"$$CHELABASE_IDENTITY_DB_PASSWORD_FILE" || [ -n "$$pw" ]
case "$$pw" in
  "" | *[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*)
    echo "identity: $$CHELABASE_IDENTITY_DB_PASSWORD_FILE must hold one base64url line" >&2
    exit 1 ;;
esac
# The user info is one argument: no password is ever in this file's text.
printf 'postgres://%s@%s/%s\n' "$$CHELABASE_IDENTITY_DB_USER:$$pw" \
  "$$CHELABASE_IDENTITY_DB_HOST" "$$CHELABASE_IDENTITY_DB_NAME" >/run/identity/database.url
unset pw
export CHELABASE_IDENTITY_DATABASE_URL_FILE=/run/identity/database.url
exec "$$@"

command:
set -e
mkdir -p /data/.neon
echo 'id=1' > /data/.neon/identity.toml
umask 077
cat > /data/.neon/pageserver.toml <<EOT
broker_endpoint='http://storage-broker:50051'
pg_distrib_dir='/usr/local/'
listen_pg_addr='0.0.0.0:6400'
listen_http_addr='0.0.0.0:9898'
http_auth_type='NeonJWT'
pg_auth_type='NeonJWT'
auth_validation_public_key_path='/run/storage-auth.pub.pem'
control_plane_api='http://storage-controller:1234/upcall/v1/'
control_plane_api_token='$$(cat /run/generations-api.jwt)'
virtual_file_io_mode='buffered'
remote_storage={ endpoint='http://seaweedfs:8333', bucket_name='neon', bucket_region='us-east-1', prefix_in_bucket='/pageserver' }
EOT
echo '{"host":"pageserver","port":6400,"http_host":"pageserver","http_port":9898,"availability_zone_id":"az-1"}' > /data/.neon/metadata.json
exec pageserver -D /data/.neon --auth-token-file=/run/safekeeper-data.jwt

command:
set -e
cd /tls
# The proxy runs as the stack's uid (it reads the stack's 0600 secrets too).
owner="1000:1000"
if [ -s tls.crt ] && openssl x509 -in tls.crt -noout -subject | grep -qF '*.localtest.me'; then
  chown "$$owner" tls.key tls.crt ca.crt
  echo "certificate for *.localtest.me exists"; exit 0
fi
[ -s ca.key ] || openssl req -x509 -newkey ec -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:P-256 -nodes \
  -keyout ca.key -out ca.crt -days 3650 -subj "/CN=Chelabase local CA"
openssl req -newkey ec -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:P-256 -nodes -keyout tls.key -out tls.csr \
  -subj "/CN=*.localtest.me"
printf 'subjectAltName=DNS:*.localtest.me\n' > ext.cnf
openssl x509 -req -in tls.csr -CA ca.crt -CAkey ca.key -CAcreateserial -days 825 \
  -extfile ext.cnf -out tls.crt
rm -f tls.csr ext.cnf
chown "$$owner" tls.key tls.crt ca.crt
chmod 600 ca.key tls.key
echo "issued a certificate for *.localtest.me"

set -e
S=http://storage-controller:1234
# The bearer goes to curl in a header file (`-H @file`), never on its command line.
umask 077
H="$$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$$H"' EXIT
{ printf 'Authorization: Bearer '; tr -d '\r\n' < /run/storcon-admin.jwt; echo; } > "$$H"
for ID in 1 2 3; do
  curl -fsS -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "@$$H" \
    -d "{\"id\":$$ID,\"created_at\":\"2023-10-25T09:11:25Z\",\"updated_at\":\"2024-08-28T11:32:43Z\",\"region_id\":\"local\",\"host\":\"safekeeper$$ID\",\"port\":5454,\"http_port\":7676,\"https_port\":null,\"version\":5957,\"availability_zone_id\":\"az-$$ID\"}" \
    $$S/control/v1/safekeeper/$$ID
  curl -fsS -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "@$$H" \
    -d '{"scheduling_policy":"Active"}' $$S/control/v1/safekeeper/$$ID/scheduling_policy
done
